edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Her Black Shield (26-16s CD by rank) eats one stun clean — bait it with a stray Q before you commit W.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Committing W-Q into an unbaited Black Shield wastes the whole combo — the shield eats the stun for free.

edits.before: Commit on Dark Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Dark Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E-Q stun package banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Morgana Dark Binding (10s CD): matchup-defining — the three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. - Her Black Shield is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — bait it before your real stun. - The 120/110/100s ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
